type DailyKey = "today";
type Counts = Record<DailyKey, number>;
type View<DailyKey> = Counts;

type Values<Key extends string> = Record<Key, number>;
export const daily: View<string> = { today: 1 };
export const exact: Values<"today"> = { today: 1 };
export const wide: Values<string> = { today: 1 };
